summary: Foresight Autonomous Holdings filed a 6-K announcing a non-binding term sheet with VisionWave Holdings for a $17.5M strategic equity investment. VisionWave will receive Foresight ordinary shares representing 45-51% of outstanding capital at a ~3x current market value premium, implying a post-money valuation of ~$35M. The investment is in VisionWave's common stock at a five-day VWAP. The board recommends the deal, highlighting defense collaboration synergies. The transaction is subject to due diligence, definitive agreements, regulatory and shareholder approvals, with no specific timeline given; the non-binding nature and equity consideration introduce execution risk.
